_readme: THE CHANGE FOLD (2026-08-25). The opposite problem to forces: not too many artifacts in too many rooms, but too few — eight rooms, seven of them 10x11, holding 27 placements between them (2 to 5 each). The ladder was already written in the map names; this fold just stops pretending each rung needs three rooms. rate / accumulation / flow / reconciliation, and the last one closes the loop by showing the first two were the same operation read in opposite directions.
